description: This Kotlin source file defines the NoteListWidgetFactory class, which implements RemoteViewsFactory for an Android app widget. It manages data retrieval and view creation for a note list widget in the Nextcloud Notes Android client, including handling intents for editing, creating, and opening notes, and populating widget views with note data.

classes.name: NoteListWidgetFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing views for a note list widget in an Android application, handling data loading, intent creation, and view population.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the factory; no specific setup needed.

methods.name: onDataSetChanged
methods.description: Refreshes the data set by querying the repository based on widget data and mode.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources; no specific cleanup needed.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of notes to display.

methods.name: getEditNoteIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch the EditNoteActivity with provided extras.

methods.name: getCreateNoteIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to start note creation, pre-populated with account and category info.

methods.name: getOpenNoteIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to open an existing note.

methods.name: getViewAt
methods.description: Generates the RemoteViews for a note at a specific position, setting up click intents and view content.

methods.name: getLoadingView
methods.description: Returns null, indicating default loading view.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of different view types; here, 2.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the note at the given position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that item IDs are stable.
